title: Probability of a tribes block condition
statement: For natural numbers $w,s$ and an index $i$ among the $sw$ coordinates, choose an input uniformly from $\{−1,1\}^{sw}$ and view it as $s$ blocks of size $w$. The probability that every coordinate in the block containing $i$, except the coordinate $i$ itself, equals $−1$ is $2^{-(w-1)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $sw$ coordinates
